Satyan Sinha

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

singlaankita2996@gmail.com | 7011973047 | Noida, New Delhi NCR Linkedin

Education

International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore		Online AI Postgraduate Diploma in ML and AI	April 2020 - June 2021

Maharaja Agrasen Institute Of Technology, GGSIPU		New Delhi Electronics and Communication Engineering Bachelor of Technology	August 2013 - June 2017

Rukmini Devi Public School	New Delhi

Science High School	April 2010 - March 2012

Experience

SBS (Sopra Banking Software) | Technical Lead	Noida, NCR | Jan - 2025 Wholesale Finance

  Led end-to-end development for time-critical releases, including design discussions, implementation, code reviews, testing, and deployment to enhance delivery and team collaboration.

  Re-architected authentication mechanism by migrating from LDAP-based auth to OAuth 2.0

(Client Credentials ow) for outbound API communication, improving security, and maintainability.

  Investigated and triaged critical/high vulnerabilities reported by Aqua Scan and OWASP tools by analyzing the application codebase to determine actual exposure and exploitability.

  Provided real-time production issue resolution as part of on-call support, ensuring minimal downtime and quick recovery of business-critical services.

SBS (Sopra Banking Software) | Module Lead	Noida, NCR | May 2022 - Dec 2024 Wholesale Finance

  Extensively worked on Product Engineering across domains like Payments, Loan Management, and Invoicing for clients such as Novuna (Hitachi Capital), BMW, Daimler, Credit Agricole, Mazda, and Santander.

  Resolved multiple high-priority defects in transaction generation ows and interest calculation engines, signi cantly reducing backlog volume by nearly 20% and improving overall system stability.

Customer Engagement Platform:

  Worked on the Accessibility projects and several tickets concerning bugs and the addition of functionalities, such as Improvements in Error Management.

Conduent (formerly Xerox) | Application Dev Engineer	Noida, NCR | July 2020 - May 2022

  Implemented barcode generation and integration within the EBT product for multiple U.S. states, enabling automated barcode printing on card carriers by FISERV.

  Worked on the CAV implementation for adding a security layer while performing POS transactions.

EdgeVerve (Infosys) | System Engineer	Pune | June 2018 - Jan 2020

  Worked with the product development team to enhance the product feature speci cation of Finacle.

Infosys | System Engineer Trainee	Mysore | Dec 2017 - June 2018

  Python, Object Oriented Design and DBMS (SQL), J2EE, REST APIs for server-side rendering, and Frontend terminologies.

Skills

Programming Languages:  Java, Python

Libraries/Frameworks:	J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JSF, Maven, Ivy, JUnit, Mockito, NPM, Spring Security, Microservices, WebServices (REST/SOAP), SOLID Principles, De- sign Patterns, Data Structures

Tools / Platforms:	Git, Gitlab CI, BitBucket, Jira, Con uence, Postman, Docker, Jenkins CI/CD, Kibana, Portainer, Jupyter

Databases:	Oracle, MySql, Postgres

Honors & Awards

  Published a research paper entitled DEEP LEARNING FOR MOLECULAR PROPERTY PREDICTION OF NOVEL COMPOUND in IRJCS Journal. Paper ID: IRJCS/Vol.08/Iss05/MYCS10081

  Received the Client Appreciation Award from the State of Georgia as part of a 7-8 member team at Conduent.
